scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Krishi Sa Sajuli Yozana - Assam
other_conditions: Only small and marginal farmers are eligible
Beneficiary must be more than 21 years old
Beneficiary should be involved in cultivation for at least three consecutive years
All Kisan Credit Card (KCC) holders are eligible to apply
Applicant must have a live bank account
Only one farmer per family shall be eligible
Tenant farmers or sharecroppers with a minimum cultivation area of 1 Acre / 3 Bighas may also be considered
benefits_summary: Each eligible farmer receives a one-time financial assistance of ₹5,000 transferred directly to purchase farm tools.
